messages:
maria_sec: Heads up — got a vuln report from external pen test about possible snapshot exposure: they were able to enumerate snapshot IDs for an internal S3-backed DB cluster. Not confirmed data exfil but we need to treat it as high priority. Thoughts on RBAC + KMS changes we should apply proactively? :eyes:

jonathan_sre: ugh. first step: audit who can create/export/restore snapshots. we should restrict restore to a new least-privilege role and require MFA/just-in-time for restore ops. also check if snapshots are encrypted with customer CMK or default service key.

felix_backend: quick checklist from infra side: 1) verify SSE-KMS on S3 buckets (list-buckets + head-object to confirm) 2) check DB cluster snapshot metadata for EncryptionKeyId 3) review any IAM policies with "ec2:CreateSnapshot" / "rds:RestoreDBInstanceFromDBSnapshot" / s3:*Snapshot* permissions.

maria_sec: agreed. what about rotation/rewrap of existing snapshots if they used wrong key? Can we re-encrypt in-place or do we need to copy?

jonathan_sre: depends on provider. For RDS/GCP SQL snapshots you often need to copy snapshot with new CMK to re-encrypt. For S3 objects you can use S3 Copy (copy-object with SSE-KMS -> new key). plan: enumerate snapshots with incorrect key id, schedule copy->re-encrypt, mark old snapshot as deprecated and restrict access until copy completes.

daria_privacy: also confirm legal/regulatory constraints before mass-copying backups (PII handling). open a ticket with legal if retention windows change.

security_bot: [new vuln-triage ticket created] VULN-2026-314: snapshot-enumeration-pry. Severity: High. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/VULN-2026-314

felix_backend: example commands (AWS):
```
# find snapshots not using CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abc...
aws rds describe-db-snapshots --query "DBSnapshots[?KmsKeyId!='arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abc...'].{Id:DBSnapshotIdentifier,Kms:KmsKeyId}"
# copy snapshot and re-encrypt
aws rds copy-db-snapshot --source-db-snapshot-identifier "$SRC" --target-db-snapshot-identifier "$TARGET" --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abc...
```
\njonathan_sre: RBAC proposal: create iam role SnapshotRestoreOperator with policies: rds:Describe*, rds:CopyDBSnapshot, rds:RestoreDBInstanceFromDBSnapshot, kms:Decrypt (for the CMK), no iam:PassRole except for a specific infra role. Enforce actions behind a workflow ticket (JIT approval).

maria_sec: audit logging: we need to make sure restore/copy/describe snapshot events are being ingested into our audit stream and alert on unusual patterns (many list operations, multiple restore attempts). Can CloudTrail/Datadog rule be created?

jonathan_sre: yes — add CloudTrail lookup events: "RestoreDBInstanceFromDBSnapshot","CopyDBSnapshot","CreateDBSnapshot". Also S3: "CompleteMultipartUpload","PutObject" for backup buckets. forward to SIEM and create rule: >3 snapshot restore/copy actions from the same principal in 15m -> pager.

daria_privacy: add requirement that any restore of backups containing production PII requires a documented justification and a ticket number in the restore request metadata.

maria_sec: KMS key policy changes: propose that CMKs used for backups disallow "Allow" to "kms:ReEncrypt*" for broad principals and add condition for aws:PrincipalTag/JIT session tag. Thoughts?

felix_backend: good idea. also rotate CMKs used for backups on a regular cadence but be careful — rotation triggers rewrap semantics. For snapshots we should test a rotation on a dev snapshot first.

security_bot: reminder: scheduled key rotation runbook exists at https://wiki.redwood.ai/sec/key-rotation-runbook — consider adding snapshot re-encrypt checklist.

maria_sec: incident response angle: if we confirm enumeration but no exfil, we still need to treat as a near-miss. action items: (A) temporarily tighten read/list access to snapshots (B) start re-encrypt/copy for any snapshot not using customer CMK (C) enable extra audit alerts (D) notify customers if any snapshot with non-customer key contained customer data (per policy). assign owners?

jonathan_sre: i'll own (A) and (C) — will scope IAM changes and CloudTrail rule.

felix_backend: i'll own (B) — spin up small workers to copy & re-encrypt, will stage on staging first. need a short maintenance window announcement.

daria_privacy: i'll draft customer notification templates if required.

maria_sec: thanks. one more question: can we block public snapshot sharing automatically? e.g., prevent making snapshot public or cross-account unless whitelisted?

jonathan_sre: yes — enforce resource-based policies and SCPs (org-level) to block Public snapshots and require an allowlist for cross-account snapshot copying. we should also add a pre-commit GitHub action to prevent infra changes that would open snapshots.

ops_bot: deploybot: IAM policy change enqueued — change set id cs-2026-07-22-1 scheduled for 2026-07-22T21:00:00Z (non-prod only). :rocket:

maria_sec: great. i'll update VULN-2026-314 with owners and start timeframes. keep me posted in this thread on blockers. :thumbsup:
